objective: Review the non-executing direct command-path fixture contract before allowing an importable helper implementation, while keeping this review from claiming native Verilator option support, direct command execution, RTL simulation, coverage-output equivalence, timing, arbitrary filelist support, automatic allocation, runtime/ABI change, or raw full-state equality.

review_decision.reason: The fixture contract is narrow and testable before implementation: it preserves ordinary Verilator build inputs, requires the expanded --sim-accel sidecar-gpu state/step spelling, requires explicit sidecar context, returns only a reference-style sidecar_plan_boundary, pins fail-closed cases, and records non-execution flags.
review_decision.weakest_point: A direct-looking Verilator argv plus a sidecar_plan_boundary field can still be over-read as implemented native support or execution authority. The implementation gate must therefore keep the helper importable and non-executing, preserve parser inputs without source closure inference, and return metadata only without running Verilator, sidecar stages, compare, timing, allocation, or runtime/ABI changes.
accepted_because: the accepted 64x1 case uses only the expanded direct native minimum and records command_must_not_execute
ordinary Verilator build inputs are preserved as input and output payload fields rather than expanded into source closure
explicit sidecar context is required before a sidecar plan boundary can be referenced
sidecar_plan_boundary is a structured reference only and is not execution authority
missing shape halves, non-positive counts, compact-only spelling, mixed compact/expanded spelling, missing context, and prepopulated sidecar-owned fields are required to fail closed
coverage_output_equivalence is only a later sidecar compare policy reference and not evidence from the fixture contract

required_next_gate.name: implement_verilator_native_option_parser_direct_command_path_fixture_gate
must_implement: a define_direct_command_path_sidecar_plan_fixture function or equivalent stable helper entrypoint
the accepted expanded native option case for --sim-accel sidecar-gpu --sim-accel-states 64 --sim-accel-steps 1

missing shape-half, non-positive count, compact-only spelling, mixed compact/expanded spelling, missing explicit sidecar context, and prepopulated sidecar-owned field rejection before any command can run
preservation of ordinary Verilator args, mdir, top module, source files, -f filelists, defines, include directories, warning flags, and remaining ordinary build inputs
a structured sidecar_plan_boundary reference with correctness_policy_ref set to coverage_output_equivalence but no compare evidence
output flags proving execution_performed, measurement_performed, timing_measured, runtime_or_abi_changed, source_closure_inferred, filelists_expanded, and automatic_gpu_allocation_used are false
contract tests that exercise accepted and rejected fixture cases without invoking Verilator, wrapper execution, sidecar stages, compare, timing, or allocation
documentation mention that the helper is direct-command-path preparation rather than native Verilator option support
must_not_claim: coverage-output equivalence for a direct native-parser flow

non_claims: not native Verilator parser implementation completion
not coverage-output equivalence for a direct native-parser flow
not source-closure or filelist dependency inference
not automatic optimal GPU allocation for any design
reports and artifacts are generated evidence, not source of truth
